templates.html:
<button type="button" class="btn-more" style="--bg:{{bg}};border-radius:{{radius}}px" aria-label="{{label}}" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="{{expanded}}"{{#if disabled}} disabled{{/if}}>
  <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><circle cx="5" cy="12" r="1.6"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="1.6"/><circle cx="19" cy="12" r="1.6"/></svg>
</button>
<style>
.btn-more {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  width: 36px; height: 36px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(36,20,48,.2);
  background: transparent;
  color: #241430;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.btn-more[aria-expanded="true"] { background: var(--bg); color: #FAF7F2; border-color: var(--bg); }
.btn-more:hover:not(:disabled):not([aria-expanded="true"]) { background: rgba(36,20,48,.08); }
.btn-more:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #241430;outline-offset:2px; }
.btn-more:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: not-allowed; }
</style>
